audit.why: 49.11% over 1515 games, LeBlanc holding stages 1-6 and Zoe taking two-items. packet.levelChart and content win[] agree; the full-layer sides read 'Skill' throughout, which is the neutral token and does not contradict a row, so no chart edits were made.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page treated Portal Jump as a scarce repositioning tool you can burst 'before'.
audit.why: Portal Jump is 11/8/5 seconds — at rank 3 it is up almost every trade. It blinks 575 units for 1 second and then blinks back, so the punish window is the return, not the exit. Advice built on catching her without it is advice that never fires.
audit.corrected: Real cooldown and the out-and-back behaviour written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[1], spikes[2] and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two properties that make Sleepy Trouble Bubble lethal were never stated, and the Spell Thief interaction was absent.
audit.why: Riot's E text: the target's Magic Resist is reduced while asleep, and the first source of damage that breaks the sleep is doubled. That is why a bubble is a kill and not a nuisance — resistances are the wrong answer, and whichever spell wakes you is the one that hurts. Separately, Spell Thief (W, 0.25s) picks up the remnants of summoner spell casts, so burning Flash or Ignite near her wave arms her.
audit.corrected: Both stated in breakdown.cooldowns, dontsFull[0], enemyWin, spikes[2] and breakdown.feeding.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns held no digit, and the packet flags 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' on this matchup.
audit.why: Bubble is 18s at rank 1 falling to 14s, Paddle Star! is 8.5s, Portal Jump is 11s falling to 5s. Every 'wait for X before you Y' line on the page needed one of those numbers and had none.
audit.corrected: Numbers added across cooldowns, dosFull[1], dosFull[2], breakdown.carry, breakdown.feeding, early and mid.

notes: All thirteen lintFindings are addressed, including three misgendered report[] entries — that exceeds the normal two-report cap, but they are mechanical MISGENDER fixes the brief requires, not de-templating rewrites, and each is a one-word change. packet.suspectNames flagged 'Portal Jump' in wants.foe[2] as a probable wrong name; it is correct (Zoe's R) and was left alone. 'Paddle Star' was missing its exclamation mark, which is part of Riot's name, and is fixed. Sleepy Trouble Bubble carries a 'terrain: creates terrain, blocks paths and dashes' derived flag, but Riot's E text describes only drowsiness, sleep, reduced MR and doubled waking damage — per the brief's rule I trusted the description and made no claim that the bubble blocks your Distortion. CHART: all seven full-layer sides read 'Skill' while packet.levelChart and content win[] both give LeBlanc stages 1-6 and Zoe two-items. Aligned the full layer to the packet as one atomic group, with phases[6].why rewritten in the same proposal so the final row's sentence describes Zoe winning it. No paired win[N] edits are proposable because the content layer already holds the correct values. Ratings left untouched — the rating perspective is inconsistent across this champion's pages.
